sultana.name: Sultana Al-Kanaan
sultana.opening: Repeat complaints are too high and the board keeps asking me about them.

topics.answer: Since month 13 the agents have a first-contact resolution target, and it counts towards their bonus.
We record calls, but I was told nobody may use the recordings for analysis without the data protection officer.
The system links contacts by mobile number. When a customer calls from another phone, it is a new customer to us.
The outsourced call-centre contract is renewed in four weeks. I need to know before then whether to change its terms.
I trust repeat contacts within seven days. I do not trust the satisfaction survey: few people answer it.
Billing callers are most of the repeats. Older customers in Al-Hamra call the most about estimated bills.
We shortened the call script in month 13 to save time. Handling time fell a lot.

mamdouh.name: Mamdouh Al-Qarawi
mamdouh.opening: Ask me anything about meters and repairs. The data are only as good as the process.

topics.answer: If the reader cannot reach the meter, the bill is an estimate: the average of the last three actual reads. The next actual read corrects it.
Readers follow routes. A billing period runs from 27 to 35 days, so a 'monthly' bill is not a month of use.
Old mechanical meters slow down: they miss roughly one and a half per cent more each year. The smart meters in Al-Nakheel register what the old ones missed.
Since the three-day target, crews close the job when they leave the site. If the leak comes back, the job is reopened.
The Al-Wurud bulk meter was over-reading for a few months. It was recalibrated in month 13.

azizah.name: Azizah Al-Matrood
azizah.opening: Tell me what you want to use and why.

topics.answer: Use only the personal data the question needs. Counts of repeat contacts need no names.
Recordings are personal data collected to handle the call. A new use needs my review first.
The contact-centre extract is Restricted. It stays inside Ghadeer's environment.
